text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I was wondering why Mejiro Ardan 
hadn't shown up for training—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I am deeply sorry for causing you 
so much trouble this time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I apologize from the bottom of my heart. I 
am truly sorry.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I found a cookbook featuring 
"Healthy Eating," and the contents are 
exceptionally informative—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I'm feeling completely 
refreshed, but I got so absorbed in 
cooking that it's gotten this late... 
Um... I'm so sorry...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since Mejiro Ardan seemed truly 
remorseful, I let the matter rest with 
just a mild warning.
